old: viṣayiṇaḥ is ambiguous in form (gen./abl. sg. or nom./acc. pl.); read here as the subject-noun of the first question ('which worldly man'); alternative: 'of the worldly man, whose adversities...'. 'astaṃ gam' = go to setting (as of the sun), i.e. disappear. gaurava = weight, dignity, respect. 'arthī' = one who asks (petitioner). Seven questions, no answers given.
why: reviewer (minor): states the agreement the form does not allow
